# question type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:questionType`](gmeow-questionType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/questionType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Classifies a question by its erotetic kind — one of the closed [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md) value vocabulary. NOT functional: a single question may carry several types at once (a 'why … and how' question is both [`gmeow:typeWhy`](../individuals/gmeow-typeWhy.md) and [`gmeow:typeHow`](../individuals/gmeow-typeHow.md)), so the property admits multiple values rather than forcing a single kind.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) -> [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:questionType`](gmeow-questionType.md) from [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) to [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) by its erotetic kind — pointing it at one or more [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md) individuals so consumers can route polar, alternative, wh, why, and how questions differently.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing exactly one type per question — it is non-functional, and [`gmeow:typeWhy`](../individuals/gmeow-typeWhy.md) / [`gmeow:typeHow`](../individuals/gmeow-typeHow.md) may co-apply — and avoid pointing it at anything outside the closed [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md) vocabulary.

### How to use

- Attach as many [`gmeow:QuestionType`](../classes/gmeow-QuestionType.md) individuals as genuinely apply to the [`Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md); read a co-applied [`gmeow:typeWhy`](../individuals/gmeow-typeWhy.md) to route the explanandum to abduction and a co-applied [`gmeow:typeHow`](../individuals/gmeow-typeHow.md) to route to the procedures extension.

### Examples
